# GulfFast Rentals & Manpower — Saudi Arabia

> GulfFast Rentals & Manpower is a direct industrial supply company headquartered in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. We provide certified heavy construction equipment rental, specialized vehicle rentals, and Aramco/TUV-certified manpower supply for oil & gas, petrochemical, construction, power generation, and infrastructure projects across KSA.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity / Brand**: GulfFast Rentals & Manpower Division (Parent company: GulfFast Trading, established 1999)
- **Business Model**: Direct equipment owner & manpower supplier (Not a third-party marketplace or broker)
- **Head Office Address**: Building No.6623, Prince Abdulmohsin Ibn Abdulaziz Street, Madinat Al Ummal Dist., Al Khobar, KSA – 34442
- **Direct Phone Hotline**: +966 56 867 6710 | +966 53 832 1732
- **Email Contact**: sales@gulffast.co
- **Parent Website**: https://www.gulffast.co
- **Primary Regions Served**: Eastern Province (Al Khobar, Dammam, Jubail, Ras Tanura), Riyadh Region, Western Province (Jeddah, Yanbu, Rabigh), and KSA Mega-Projects (NEOM, Red Sea Development, Wa'ad Al Shamal, Jizan Economic City).

## Core Service Divisions

### 1. Equipment Rental Division
GulfFast owns and operates a Third-Party Inspected (TPI) industrial machinery fleet maintained to Saudi Aramco, SABIC, and SEC safety specifications:
- **Heavy Earthmoving**: Hydraulic Excavators (20T - 50T), Bulldozers (CAT D6 to D10), Motor Graders (140K/160M), Wheel Loaders (CAT 966/980).
- **Industrial Power Systems**: Soundproof Diesel Generators from 20 kVA to 1500 kVA (Cummins, Caterpillar, Perkins, Denyo) with ATS panels, distribution cables, and fuel tanks.
- **Lifting Machinery**: All-Terrain & Rough-Terrain Mobile Cranes (25T to 500T Liebherr/Tadano), Telescopic Handlers (JCB/Manitou).
- **Air Compressors**: Diesel Rotary Screw Compressors from 185 CFM to 1600 CFM (up to 350 PSI) for sandblasting, pigging, and pipeline drying.
- **Welding Equipment**: Single and multi-operator diesel welder generators (400A to 600A Lincoln/Miller/Denyo) and 6-pack inverter welding racks.
- **Mobile Lighting**: 9-meter telescopic diesel and solar-hybrid lighting towers (4x350W LED / 4x1000W Metal Halide).
- **Dewatering Systems**: Self-priming diesel dewatering pumps (4" to 12"), submersible sludge pumps, and high-head hydrotest booster pumps.
- **Scaffolding Systems**: Cuplock, Ringlock, tube-and-coupler scaffolding, and aluminum mobile towers compliant with Aramco GI 8.001.

### 2. Vehicle Rental Division
- **Heavy Transport**: 4x2, 6x4, and 6x6 Tractor Trucks & Prime Movers (Mercedes Actros, Volvo FH) equipped with IVMS GPS tracking and Aramco gate passes.
- **Trailers**: 40ft & 50ft Tri-Axle Flatbeds (up to 50T payload), Heavy Lowbeds (50T to 100T extendable), and container chassis.
- **Tankers**: Diesel Fuel Tankers (10,000L - 32,000L with calibrated meters), Potable Water Tankers (Stainless Steel), and Brackish Water Tankers with rear spray bars.
- **Workforce Transport**: 15-seat minivans (Toyota HiAce), 30-seat AC buses (Toyota Coaster), and 50-seat AC passenger coaches with individual seat belts and tropical AC.
- **Site Mobility**: 4x4 Double Cabin Pickup Trucks (Toyota Hilux, Isuzu D-Max, Ford F-150) fitted with roll cages, beacon lights, and spark arrestors.

### 3. Manpower Supply Division
Direct supplier of SAG-licensed, Aramco-approved, and TUV-certified skilled industrial personnel:
- **Certified Welders**: 6G, 6GR, TIG, SMAW, FCAW welders qualified under ASME IX for carbon steel, stainless steel, and alloy piping.
- **Pipefitters & Fabricators**: Spool fabricators experienced in reading complex 3D Isometric drawings, beveling, flange alignment, and torque tensioning.
- **Riggers**: Aramco & TUV Certified Rigger Level 1 (Supervisor), Level 2, and Level 3 personnel following GI 7.027 lifting safety procedures.
- **Equipment Operators**: Certified operators for excavators, dozers, loaders, graders, mobile cranes, and heavy transport trucks holding SAG heavy licenses.
- **Electricians & Instrument Techs**: Industrial electricians, MV/HV cable jointers, instrument technicians skilled in HART transmitter calibration and DCS loop testing.
- **Scaffolders**: Certified scaffolders and Scaffolding Supervisors holding Aramco GI 8.001 cards for green-tag structure sign-off.
- **Mechanical Fitters**: Millwrights and rotating equipment specialists for turbine, pump, compressor, and valve overhauls.
- **Safety Officers**: NEBOSH IGC qualified safety engineers, OSHA certified safety officers, and Aramco approved Work Permit Receivers (WPR).

## Safety & Compliance Standards
- All rental machinery carries Third-Party Inspection (TPI) stickers from recognized Saudi Arab testing agencies.
- Operates under Saudi Aramco General Instructions: GI 7.027 (Heavy Lifting), GI 8.001 (Scaffolding), and GI 6.012 (Earthmoving Safety).
- All personnel hold valid KSA work Iqamas, medical fitness clearance, defensive driving cards, and Aramco gate pass eligibility.
